title: P300 dataset BI2012 from a "Brain Invaders" experiment
description: EEG recordings from 25 healthy volunteers playing Brain Invaders, a visual P300 brain-computer interface modeled on the video game Space Invaders. Data were recorded from 16 electrodes at GIPSA-lab, Grenoble, in 2012, using a training-test design with Target and NonTarget flashes of alien groups. The dataset supports P300 detection and BCI classification benchmarking.
methods_description: 16-channel wet Ag/AgCl EEG was recorded with a NeXus-32 amplifier (MindMedia/TMSi) at 128 Hz using OpenVibe, with a hardware common average reference and ground at FZ. Participants viewed 36 aliens flashing in 12 groups of 6, with 12 flashes per repetition (2 Target, 10 non-Target). The training session comprised 8 Targets with 8 repetitions each (128 Target and 640 non-Target trials), followed by an online session with three levels of distractor configurations.
